kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem delete-log-store --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --role-for 1733260000000 --log-user-id 1733260000000 --log-region-id cn-hangzhou --log-project-name 'aliyun-cloudsiem-channel-173326*******-cn-hangzhou' --log-store-name rds-logstore --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteLogStore

parameters.help_en:
The region where the data management center of Cloud Threat Detection and Response is located. Select the region of the management center based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: Assets are located in the Chinese mainland.
ap-southeast-1: Assets are located outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response message. Valid values:
zh (default): Chinese.
en: English.
Note: This parameter is actually required. If it is not provided, the API returns a 400 error: "The specified Lang can not be empty."
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文。
注意：本参数实际为必填项，未提供时 API 返回 400 错误「The specified Lang can not be empty.」
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user whose perspective the administrator switches to
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user for data ingestion
parameters.name: log_user_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the log storage region
parameters.name: log_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Simple Log Service project. Only channel-type projects are supported. The format is aliyun-cloudsiem-channel-{user ID}-{region}. You can obtain the project name by calling ListLogProjects.
Note: This parameter is actually required. If it is not provided, the API returns a 400 error: "SLS log project name is empty."
parameters.help_zh:
日志服务项目名称。仅支持 channel 类型项目，格式为 aliyun-cloudsiem-channel-{用户ID}-{地域}，可通过 ListLogProjects 获取。
注意：本参数实际为必填项，未提供时 API 返回 400 错误「SLS log project name is empty.」
parameters.name: log_project_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the Simple Log Service Logstore
parameters.name: log_store_name
